description: The pie chart represents the distribution of task types in a study on generative AI's use in journalism. There are two categories shown: 'Article generation' and 'Generation'. 'Article generation' accounts for 83.2% of the tasks, depicted in red, while 'Generation' makes up 16.8% of the tasks, shown in yellow. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the segments are ordered by size, with 'Article generation' being the largest and 'Generation' the smallest. There is no legend present, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their size and color differentiation.
